annotations.text:
GAME DAY (Option B) — chosen direction
Program logo + primary_color in the header; opponents render through TeamCrest: their uploaded logo, or initials on their primary_color when there is none (shown here). Opponent names, colors and scores are sample data.

iPad Pro landscape
At lg the app caps the screen at 768px (max-w-tablet). Two columns: the press-box tasks on the left, recent games on the right so a coach can open any report in one tap. Regular iPad / portrait uses the phone layout centered.

CURRENT
What the home screen looks like today, for comparison.

A · SCOREBOARD — bold, broadcast feel
The record is the hero. Last 5 results as a scoreboard strip, next game as a ticket.

C · BENTO — everything at a glance
Modular tiles; densest option, scales up well on iPad.

D · SEASON TIMELINE — the schedule is the home
One scroll tells the season story with a NOW marker on the next game.

E · LEADERS BOARD — coach-facing, stats-forward
Season leaders with bars, team per-game numbers. (Names and stats are sample data.)

T1 · GAMEDAY PROGRAM — printed paper, ink, one red
The folded program you buy at the gate. Cream stock with a paper grain, Big Shoulders Display for numbers and names, Source Serif italics for the small print. Numbered sections and hairline rules instead of cards; the only color is dragon red, used sparingly.

T2 · TURF & CHALK — the field itself
Deep turf green with faint yard lines and sideline hash marks behind everything. Chalk-white 2px borders, first-down yellow for the one thing that matters next. Alumni Sans + Atkinson Hyperlegible, chosen for press-box glare.

T3 · BROADCAST — TV scorebug, light studio
Light studio gray with a black scorebug header and red slash. Angled clip-paths instead of rounded corners, Chakra Petch for the on-air type, a blinking LIVE dot on the next-game eyebrow. The one light-mode dark-chrome option.

T4 · VARSITY — letterman felt, chenille, cream
Navy felt with a red/cream stripe across the top, a cream record patch, the next game as a red felt patch with a stitched inner border. Graduate for the chenille lettering, Work Sans underneath. Warm, handmade, nothing glows.

SAME LAYOUT, FOUR SKINS
Every board here is the chosen Game Day structure from page 1 — header + record, next-game hero, last game with its four reports, season rows, tab bar — re-clothed. Nothing was moved; only type, color, texture and shape changed. Pick one, or point at pieces of two and they get merged.

B1 · BROADCAST, REFINED — phone
The T3 direction carried through. New: a LAST 5 result strip under the record, an angular icon set drawn to sit with Chakra Petch (square caps, mitre joins), a whistle for Game Setup, subtitles on every season row. Hover/press states on cards and quick actions.

B2 · GAME IN PROGRESS
When a game is live the next-game hero becomes a scorebug: red LIVE bar with quarter and clock, both crests, score, possession arrow, down & distance, plays logged, and one amber RESUME ENTRY button. Everything below stays where it was.

B3 · iPad Pro landscape
Two columns at the 768 cap. Left: next game + season rows (press-box tasks). Right: five recent games, each with its stats state chip (amber = to review, green = final, gray = not started) and the opponent's color as the left rule — one tap to any report.

B4 · ICON SET
24px grid, 2px stroke, square caps, mitre joins. Goalpost for Home, jersey for Roster, headset for Program (press box), whistle for Game Setup, film strip for Plays, box-score grid for Box. Tell me which ones to swap.
